production.description: Marks the environment production (ADR 0147): flag activate and flag audit refuse an owner waiver as proof here, so a flag rests on a live run. Unset reads as false; the local environment keeps the waiver (ADR 0127).

nodeCount.description: How many nodes the environment runs (ADR 0152). Unset reads as 1, so every existing overlay keeps its meaning. The feasibility check and the capacity budget read this one fact.

committedFraction.description: The share of the one-node budget that app quotas may commit, from 0 to 1 (ADR 0152; owner decision on #1480). Unset reads as 0.8.

cluster.description: The cluster settings of a managed environment (provider managed only).

kubelet.description: The kubelet's measured reserves and memory eviction floor (ADR 0152). Absent until the vps measurement records them; a budget with an absent reserve is not judged.

diskReserve.description: The disk the platform keeps back from diskSize, a size in GiB such as 20g (ADR 0152). Absent until measured.

k3d.description: The k3d cluster (provider k3d only). The k3s image resolves from versions.images.k3s and the kubeContext must be k3d-<clusterName>.

hostAddress.description: The loopback IPv4 address the host port binds (ADR 0131).

optional.description: Skipped by the check that refuses kore local up when a host port is taken. The port is still published.

featureFlag.description: The feature flag that makes this mapping real. While it is off the mapping is not created, compared for drift or probed; turning it on for a cluster created without it needs a recreate.

optOut.description: This environment opts out of the mapping, for a developer whose native service holds the host port: it is not created, compared for drift or probed, and the rest of the platform comes up. Turning it back on for a cluster created without it needs a recreate.

platform.description: The platform's one name field. The domain is written here and nowhere else: the Gateway hostname, each chart's platform domain and the delivery path's value derive from it (ADR 0042). The organization identifier builds the platform organization's wildcard hostname *.<organizationId>.<domain>, the registry hostname registry.<organizationId>.<domain> and the host DNS check's <organizationId>.<domain>, and, behind their flags, the shared Gateway's route domain, the Organization zone default and the database routes; the platform Organization resource's name and the golden-path load test's hostname still use the literal platform. A service host is <service>.<organizationId>.<domain>.

domain.description: A lowercase DNS name of at least two labels, for example kore.internal.

organizationId.description: The platform organization's identifier, one lowercase DNS label, for example platform.

internalDomain.description: The domain the internal Gateway's names live under (spec #1612). Unset, it is the platform domain. With gateways.external declared it is required and must be internal.<domain>.

imageInventory.description: Inventory mode and enrollment rule (ADR 0056): enforce labels every catalog platform namespace except enrollmentExemptions with policy.sigstore.dev/include before the inventory runs; audit labels none.

exemptionCheck.description: Mode of the policy-exemption check, audit or enforce (ADR 0056 mode); unset reads as audit. Accepted and validated now; the exemption check that consumes it is a later ticket under #613.

providerOwnedCRDGroups.description: API groups whose CRDs the environment's provider ships (ADR 0088): group to reason. The CRD ownership status counts them as provider-owned; only groups the provider ships are allowed (k3d: k3s.cattle.io, helm.cattle.io), and a catalog component may not also own the group.

features.description: Feature flags (ADR 0077): flag name to boolean, off unless true. Passed into local chart values as features.<name>.

gateway.description: The single Gateway field (spec #1612, the expand step). It is accepted beside gateways.internal, and when both are declared they name the same Gateway.

gateways.description: The environment's Gateways (spec #1612). internal is required once gateways is declared; external is optional and carries the public HTTPS routes. The certificate issuer is chosen per Gateway here, never per app.

issuer.description: The certificate issuer this Gateway uses, one lowercase DNS label, for example kore-local-ca.
